items.title: For a constructible sheaf the vanishing and surjectivity statements are unchanged by replacing it by its extension by zero from a dense open
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma transfers the vanishing and surjectivity statements of the standing situation from a constructible sheaf F to its extension by zero from a dense open, and back (statement lines 15490-15497). The proof (proof lines 15499-15545) uses the short exact sequence attached to the dense open, identifies the cohomology of the quotient term i_*i^{-1}F with the cohomology of the zero-dimensional complement via finiteness of the closed immersion and the Leray spectral sequence, and observes that the complement, a disjoint union of spectra of algebraically closed fields, has no higher cohomology, so the comparison along the long exact sequence is an equivalence. H2: one exact sequence comparison with two identifications, written out.
